concept: A tale of two halves. The hero puts the problem in muted grey ('1-0 down at half-time') and the turning point in white ('Then Bellingham came on'), with the score and the 10-game winning run underneath. Slide 2 replays the night as a minute-by-minute timeline so the five second-half goals stack up one after another. Slide 3 is one giant number, 15 points from five games, the reward for the comeback. The last slide widens out to Arsenal and City being held, then hands fans the question. Football green, pitch lines and type only: no player photos, no club or league logos.
caption:
1-0 down at half-time. Then Real Madrid scored five.

Ivan Perisic's 32nd-minute penalty had PSV ahead at the Bernabeu on Tuesday. Jude Bellingham started on the bench and came on at half-time. Federico Valverde levelled and Bellingham's volley on the hour went in off the post. Kylian Mbappe scored in the 64th and 84th minutes and Vinicius Junior added a fifth in the 87th.

Why it matters: that is 10 straight wins in all competitions. Real Madrid have 15 points from five league-phase games and are three clear of PSG, who host Roma on Wednesday.

The English sides could not keep up. Arsenal drew 1-1 with Dortmund (Gyokeres 10', Beier 55') and Manchester City needed Rayan Cherki's 86th-minute goal to draw 2-2 with Napoli. Arsenal host Real Madrid in two weeks.

Can anyone stop Real Madrid this season? Tell us below.
